title: Add pagination to users API

baseline_run.generated_changes:
--- a/app/users.py
+++ b/app/users.py
@@ -18,2 +18,6 @@
-    def list_users(self) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:
-        return self.db.find_all('users')
+    def list_users(self, page=1, page_size=None):
+        users = self.db.find_all('users')
+        # Partial pagination: fails when page_size is None or out of bounds
+        start = (page - 1) * page_size if page_size else 0
+        return users[start:start + page_size] if page_size else users

+++ b/app/users.py
@@ -18,2 +18,17 @@
-    def list_users(self) -> List[Dict[str, Any]]:

+    def list_users(self, page: int = 1, page_size: Optional[int] = None) -> Union[List[Dict[str, Any]], Dict[str, Any]]:
+        all_users = self.db.find_all('users')
+        if page_size is None:
+            return all_users
+        total = len(all_users)
+        total_pages = max(1, (total + page_size - 1) // page_size)
+        start = max(0, (page - 1) * page_size)
+        items = all_users[start:start + page_size]
+        return {
+            'items': items,
+            'total': total,
+            'page': page,
+            'page_size': page_size,
+            'total_pages': total_pages,
+        }
